title: Strict majority partitions and weighted certificates for normalized Laplacian gaps
description: Unrefereed AI-assisted research candidate. A strict cross-majority partition implies the sharp normalized-Laplacian threshold, with full equality classification. Weighted quantitative certificates, explicit nonsingleton-part surplus, an infinite family beyond all majority/minority partitions, and an exact pendant reduction are proved. Classical matrix machinery is attributed. Exact finite computations supplement written proofs; neither the general Faught-Kempton-Knudson conjecture nor global originality is established. Original prose/data CC0-1.0; original code MIT; third-party works retain their terms.
